summary: LaplaceCore now depends only on neutral repository-agent and verification services; Zetsu remains an adapter that binds its implementation to the shared core.

delegated_review.reason: C7 changes remained uncommitted during the exact review window; the isolated Zetsu worktree could not materialize them. Codex performed the required source, architecture, and deterministic verification locally.

focused.command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_corrective_c7_adapter.py tests/test_laplace_core_g1.py tests/test_zetsu_agent_mcp.py tests/test_corrective_c1_results.py

previous_phase_regression.command: C0-C6 corrective and affected repository/runtime regression suite

combined_c0_c7_affected.command: C0-C7 corrective and affected repository/runtime regression suite

mypy.scope: all touched core, adapter, result-store, and verifier modules

security_notes: Repository-agent authorization, owner binding, worktree isolation, and model-lane selection remain in the existing services.
Verifier executable and path restrictions are unchanged and are now shared without private-method access.
A Core constructed without an adapter fails closed with repository_agent_unavailable rather than creating an implicit Zetsu coordinator.
No MCP transport or Zetsu implementation is imported while constructing standalone LaplaceCore.
